Question: Which method performs best for the "Representation" task when the view is "Novel"?
Evidence:
[E1] (text, Section Table 1, page 7): Table 1. Quantitative results on synthetic data. Rows are different combination of tasks and methods (three applications, two view protocols, our two methods). Columns are different data. Error is measured as mean DSSIM across the data set (less is better). measured as mean DSSIM across the data set (less is better). Task View Method Error PNT ENV Representation (Sec. 3.2) Same OUR .105 .123 RM++ .143 .160 Novel OUR .144 .164 RM++ .181 .193 Learn-to-learn (Sec. 3.3) Same OUR .106 .131 SGD .105 .123 Novel OUR .165 .173 SGD .144 .164 Segmentation (Sec. 3.4) Same OUR .113 .122 KMEANS .132 .136 Novel OUR .161 .154 KMEANS .172 .164
[E2] (text, Section Figure 7, page 7): Figure 7. Results of our DAM representation trained using stochas- tic gradient descent (1st column) , our DAMs produced by our learning-to-learn network (2nd column) as well as a reference (3rd column) in a novel-view task. measured as mean DSSIM across the data set (less is better). Task View Method Error PNT ENV Representation (Sec. 3.2) Same OUR .105 .123 RM++ .143 .160 Novel OUR .144 .164 RM++ .181 .193 Learn-to-learn (Sec. 3.3) Same OUR .106 .131 SGD .105 .123 Novel OUR .165 .173 SGD .144 .164 Segmentation (Sec. 3.4) Same OUR .113 .122 KMEANS .132 .136 Novel OUR .161 .154 KMEANS .172 .164
[E3] (text, Section 5.2, page 6): Tbl. 1 , top part, shows results as mean error across the data set. We see that for all data sets our method is a better representation in terms of having a lower DSSIM error. The difference in error is more pronounced for N OVEL V IEW than for S AME V IEW . A detailed plot of error distribution is seen in Fig. 6 , left. This is, as classic reﬂectance map captures appearance for a ﬁxed viewer location, for changing geometry, but does not generalize when the viewer moves. Arguably, classic RMs look qualitatively plausible without a reference, but only have low quantitative similarity (SSIM) in novel views.

claims.text: The method 'OUR' performs best for the 'Representation' task when the view is 'Novel', with an error of .144 for PNT and .164 for ENV.

claims.text: The method 'RM++' performs worse than 'OUR' for the 'Representation' task when the view is 'Novel', with an error of .181 for PNT and .193 for ENV.
